academicDiscussion.professorPost: Some podcast producers use a full-season podcast release, while others follow a weekly episode schedule. Do you think a podcast series should release its entire season at once rather than publish one episode each week? Why or why not?

studentPosts.name: Maya
studentPosts.post: I support a full-season podcast release because it gives listeners control over pacing. Someone with a long commute might hear several episodes together, while a busy listener can pause without waiting for the publisher. Immediate access also makes it easier to revisit earlier details before reaching the ending.

studentPosts.name: Jonah
studentPosts.post: I prefer a weekly episode schedule because waiting creates shared anticipation and ongoing audience discussion. Listeners can compare predictions after each installment, and the creators have time to respond to questions or release bonus material. If every episode appears immediately, the conversation may peak quickly and disappear.
